program: APPUI-01-P2-STAGE-SHELL-01 — Stage-to-Shell Adjacency and Live Workspace Composition 01
resolved_composition_law: The dark Stage is the dominant live-work surface; shell, contextual inspector and support material remain subordinate.
Light and Dark shell presentations preserve the same Stage meanings and interaction hierarchy.
Watch posture may become sparse and Inspect posture may add contextual detail without changing the application information architecture.
Keyboard focus, creator selection, current opportunity, Character agency and infrastructure status remain distinct meanings.
Creator-authority surfaces remain outside Character cones.
Wide, medium and narrow layouts preserve selected identity, disclosure, Stage origin and exact return semantics without requiring simultaneous columns.
Five Characters remain a composition witness rather than an active-Scene cardinality law.
reserved_not_hardened: transcript / recent-history placement, density, Beat terminology and transcript-dependent motion
timer / Pause semantics or auto-advance behavior
creator intervention taxonomy, confirmation and effect semantics
provider / model / cost and Performer assignment semantics

repairs: The first successful browser run reported ten internal overflow witnesses caused by Character name/state text extending beyond cone boxes. Name/state geometry was constrained without changing cone meaning or overall Stage composition.

The first visual render exposed double-encoded punctuation and identity text. The source was repaired from mojibake to exact UTF-8, restoring KYMÆAN, em dashes, arrows, middle dots and not-equal signs before the full matrix reran.
recursive_audit.final_visual_review: Wide and narrow final renders are mechanically and semantically clean after both repairs.

explicit_non_authority: No Stage successor, cone-carrier redesign or replacement of PKT-STAGE-CORE-02.
No transcript-dependent Stage motion or Q-DESIGN-02 activation.
No final palette, typography, material, iconography, motion token, WinUI or native implementation authority.
No Product/Phase-D resolution of Scene, Perspective, Take, consequence, provider, Performer or persistence mechanics.

conclusion.next_boundary: Detail current-performance and immediate causal-context hierarchy as a static Stage-adjacent composition without hardening transcript ontology, cadence or motion.
